original_test_intent: Demonstrate that the physical GPU power-brake input limits loaded power below 150W when asserted low and that removing the approved rework restores loaded power above 250W.
original_method: A qualified operator identifies the exact board/pin and follows approved de-energized short/removal procedure with inspection; agent records state confirmation, runs the same pinned workload and stable sampling policy under independent monitoring in asserted and restored states, compares each distribution to its strict threshold, then verifies rework removal, normal health and logs.
manual_activity: Qualified hardware operator exclusively asserts/removes the power-brake rework and inspects restoration; GPU/power owner approves workload and thresholds and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Board-revision-specific schematic/rework procedure and exact pin/net
Qualified operator and safe de-energized/current-limited handling policy
Power source/unit/sample cadence/stability rule and stable GPU identity
Independent electrical/thermal monitoring, hard abort and recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Agent must never actuate, short or instruct blind probing
Operator confirms power-safe state before contact changes and inspects for adjacent shorts
Use current-limited/stable supply and independent power/thermal monitoring
Abort on wrong pin, odor/smoke/overcurrent, limit, reset or stale/malformed telemetry
Stop load, de-energize as required, remove rework and prove normal restored state before completion
agent_execution_scope: Run approved workload and collect power/health evidence in each state
Stop/cleanup and report without physical actuation or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact rework, operator, workload and sampling oracle
Witness/attest asserted and restored physical states

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The high-level split is correct but it lacks exact workload/read commands, sample stability and electrical controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After operator assertion confirmation, run the pinned workload and read-only power logger; repeat identically only after operator removal/restoration confirmation. No command may control the pin.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Strict `<150W` asserted and `>250W` restored thresholds plus ten-minute attendance/thirty-minute machine window remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record immutable physical-state attestations and synchronized workload/utilization/power traces; apply identical steady-state sampling to both states and preserve restoration inspection.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns two spot readings into attributable state-controlled measurements without automating the hazardous actuation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A software throttle or one-state reading cannot substitute for the physical signal transition and both thresholds.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Board telemetry may be filtered or delayed; sampling window and independent measurement source must be approved to avoid transient false results.

project_override_considerations: Hardware owner defines board revision, exact active-low net, whether rework requires depopulation/jumper fixture and safe energization sequence.
expected_evidence: Approved schematic/rework procedure, operator identity and board/GPU identity
Before/asserted/restored inspection or photo attestations with timestamps
Workload/tool hashes, exact argv, utilization and identical sampling policy
Raw asserted and restored power traces with units plus `<150W`/`>250W` calculations
Independent electrical/thermal trace, abort record and post-restoration GPU/log health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently defines active-low physical power-brake assertion and two state-specific power thresholds.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The mandatory operator/rework procedure is a provisionable prerequisite; manual involvement alone is not BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Preserves physical coverage and both thresholds while preventing autonomous shorting and requiring controlled, repeatable two-state measurement and restoration.
independent_technical_reasoning: The power-brake function is a hardware signal path, so software power caps cannot validate it. A valid comparison requires the same target, workload and sampling method in both physical states; a single transient can cross either threshold without demonstrating stable behavior. Because an incorrect short can damage the board before software detects it, qualified de-energized handling and independent electrical protection are primary controls, not optional evidence.
